This crucial step allowed them to pause frames and accurately document their entire contents for their claim.

Group-IB uncovered WindRelay, a new Android malware that pairs with SpyNote RAT to relay NFC card data in real time, enabling instant bank fraud in 13 minutes.

#WindRelay #SpyNote #AndroidMalware #NFCRelay #BankFraud

external.description: A single phone call with a fraudster can now result, within the same session, in a loan taken out in the victim's name and unauthorized purchases charged to their bank card. Researchers at Group-IB have uncovered a new attack scheme in which threat actors combine the SpyNote remote access trojan with a previously undocumented Android malware called WindRelay. WindRelay's role is precise and singular: it transmits bank card data via NFC in real time to a device controlled by the attacker.
external.title: WindRelay and SpyNote RAT Combo Turns Android Into NFC Card Relay for Bank Fraud
